name: Shore ledge
plain: Bare bedrock breaks out as ledge along the shore, more where the ground is steep, from the low-tide line up into the trees.

params.blocks: from rock_rules.json for the bedrock under it (Cadillac granite blocky, Bar Harbor Formation layered)

confidence: medium: curves from World's levels/downeast/coast_rules.json (21 Oct), checked against the Bar Harbor shore and cited above; Matt's field corrections still to come

sources.cite: Maine Geological Survey, Coastal Marine Geologic Environments (habitat_detail classes 1, 2)

sources.note: jointing, strike and block size per formation: the ledge builder's 'auto' rule (Matt's corrections pending)
the rule's purpose, in his words

where_note: habitat_detail's ledge (1) and barren (20) say where the survey maps rock; a flat ledge is still ledge, slope lifts it where the survey says boulder or forest
